title: replyTo validated against stale chatId not resolved chat
description: In peer_deliver step 6, replyTo is validated by comparing referenced.chat_id == msg.chat_id (peer-supplied). In the stale-chatId path (case b), resolved_chat_id \!= msg.chat_id. No message has chat_id == stale_id, so any replyTo attempt in this path returns 'nonexistent message' even when the reply references a valid message in the actual adopted chat. The new message is stored in resolved_chat_id but the replyTo check used the wrong chat ID, making threaded replies impossible whenever a peer sends with a stale chatId.
